claimsOverview.title: Claims & payouts
claimsOverview.sub: Every claim against a courier and the money each courier holds, has paid and still owes, in one place.

k.dueOffSub: Deadlines are off in Delivery settings

ledger.title: Claims ledger
ledger.sub: Lost, damaged, short cash and more. Orders, Couriers and Finance read this same list.

claimsOverview.off: Courier claims are switched off, so the steps below are hidden. Raising and moving claims is switched on in Delivery settings.

money.title: Courier money
money.sub: What each courier holds for us, what its statements paid, a payout asked and not yet paid, and the claims it still owes. Nothing is asked or paid from here.
money.noPerm: The money side needs the permission to see payments.
money.none: No courier holds money or owes a claim.

opt.d: How many claims and how many of the latest payout requests this page lists at once. A display size only.
opt.readOnly: You can see these sizes. Changing them needs the permission to change settings.

err.STALE: Someone saved first. The page shows their values; check and save again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: A number is out of range.
